cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort dinner, then give your spare key back. Have you booked anywhere?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I never gave you a spare key. Where did you get it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll get a table first. Pick somewhere; I'll make the call.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked. Did my sister give you that key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll ask her if she wants to come. Could you add a place if she says yes?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 manages dinner and key return; A3 offers booking labor to avoid provenance; A5 adapts to B existing booking by proposing a conditional invitation instead of answering the sister-source question.

responseLogic.evidence: B4 names sister only as possible source; A5 explicitly proposes asking her and adding a place only if she agrees, so attendance and headcount are not silently assumed.

relationship.evidence: B2 asks a legitimate key-origin question and B4 both answers the booking question and narrows the provenance inquiry.

heightening.evidence: B4 booked table plus named sister directly create A5 a new meal task without answering the exposing detail.

specificity.evidence: A1 key and dinner, B2 no gift of key establish the mystery; A5 future invitation remains concrete and conditional.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 invitation action and conditional booking request are the complete diversion; no extra statement of why A is avoiding the question.
